answer: Reputation-decayed registration escrow. Each new agent identity posts a small refundable deposit plus a per-identity micro-fee that scales with the square root of identities registered from the same funding graph in the last 30 days. Fees flow to a shared ocean of rebates for honest long-lived agents. Enforcement: deposits unlock only after 90 days of non-collusive activity; early exit forfeits 70%. An attacker flooding N identities pays superlinear fees and stranded capital, while honest agents recover costs like an oasis in a reef of churn.
